name: Classic Creamy Mustard Red Potato Salad
sub: Red potatoes · 4 side servings · estimated macros
text:
POTATO PREPARATION
Scrub 1½ lb red potatoes; leave skins on and cut into ¾-inch pieces. Cover with cold water by an inch, salt lightly, bring to a gentle boil, and simmer 10–15 minutes until just fork-tender. Drain well and spread out for 5–10 minutes.

INGREDIENTS
1½ lb red potatoes (prepared above)
½ cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
½ cup diced celery
¼ cup finely diced onion
¼ cup chopped dill pickles
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp smoked paprika, plus more on top
Salt and black pepper to taste

METHOD
1. Sprinkle vinegar over warm potatoes, toss gently, and cool until barely warm.
2. Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, garlic powder, paprika, and pepper.
3. Fold in potatoes, eggs, celery, onion, and pickles.
4. Taste before adding salt.
5. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Stir before serving; loosen with a spoonful of water or pickle juice if needed.

ESTIMATED MACROS
Per ¼ batch: 211 kcal · 9.9 g protein · 30.6 g carbs · 5.8 g fat · 3.6 g fiber.
Whole batch: 844 kcal · 39.7 g protein · 122.4 g carbs · 23.2 g fat.

NUTRITION STATUS
Generic estimates saved from conversation, October 25, 2026; not calculated from saved brand labels. Each recipe makes 4 side servings. A serving is ¼ of the finished batch, not a fixed weight. Brand, bacon size, and optional ingredients affect totals.
Refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.
